method: In the unchanged closed-STL frame, each connected original support-contact footprint beneath the overhang stock, with a bounding-box dimension at least 50 mm and area at least 0.1 mm², must retain emitted interface-envelope contact. Native interface bead envelopes are expanded by half the saved 0.5 mm spacing. Small bridge surfaces intentionally exempted by the 50 mm control have no interface-presence requirement.
scope: Presence of automatic interface beneath the larger unchanged overhang targets; not complete contact coverage, stiffness, physical cleanup or print outcome.
